subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young East Asian woman in <Picture 1>, around eighteen to twenty years old, with long dark-brown wavy hair gathered into a high side ponytail on her right, tied with a pink satin ribbon bow from which a pale-pink teddy-bear charm hangs, wearing a cropped pink cardigan over a white lace camisole, a white high-waisted pleated skirt, white mid-calf socks and pink lace-up sneakers, slender build about one hundred sixty-five centimeters tall with narrow shoulders and long legs, oval face with slim almond eyes, light-brown irises, a small nose bridge and pale-pink lips on fair skin with fine visible pores.
<Subject 2> is the dawn meadow environment in <Picture 2>, featuring low drifting morning mist across tall wild grasses, warm-gold sunrise light entering from the left as the primary key, a cool cyan-silver moonlit counter-tone gradient in the upper right, oblique volumetric godray shafts cutting through the mist, and softly defocused rolling mountain silhouettes in muted teal-grey along a low horizon.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized vocal track of the source song, reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio; it carries <Subject 1>'s sung performance (S1).

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is a ten-second widescreen music-video close-up passage in which <Subject 1> (S1) lip-syncs, directly to camera within <Subject 2> at break of day, the exact English lyric lines carried by <Audio 1>, in the precise order they appear in the source vocal: "You wake within me — Wake within me — You're in my heart forever — You wake within me — Wake within me". The audio is copied 1:1 from <Audio 1> (fully_copy); the sung words leaving her lips are identical to the source vocal and no re-synthesis occurs. She is captured in a slow, intimate medium close-up (head and shoulders) angled three-quarter toward the lens, eyes open and bright, lips parted and articulating every sung word clearly in time with the copied track. The passage is a single continuous shot with no cuts. <Subject 1> supplies the character identity and costume, <Subject 2> supplies the environment, lighting direction and atmospheric texture.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - the high right side ponytail with pink satin ribbon bow and pale-pink teddy-bear charm, cropped pink cardigan, white lace camisole, white high-waisted pleated skirt, white mid-calf socks and pink lace-up sneakers, slender proportions and facial features are all retained without substitution.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - the drifting low morning mist, tall wild grasses, left warm-gold key light, upper-right cool cyan counter-tone, oblique godray shafts and low defocused mountain horizon are retained as the continuous environment.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video is a clean high-key music-video passage shot on thirty-five millimeter film with fine grain, a fifty millimeter lens at f one point eight for shallow depth of field, gentle lens bloom, and a strict two-tone grade of warm-gold key from frame left against cool cyan-grey counter-light from frame right; it is a single continuous shot with no transition effects and no hard cuts.
[Shot 1] The camera holds a slow, breathing medium close-up of <Subject 1> (S1) framed head-and-shoulders and angled three-quarter toward the lens, her body centered with weight settled evenly and one hand loosely lifted near her chest as if mid-gesture of singing. She keeps her eyes open and engaged, gaze softly locking with the viewer. The sole voice source is <Audio 1> (fully_copy); she lip-syncs precisely to that copied vocal track, articulating the verbatim lyric lines in the exact order and timing of the source audio:
<|lyrics_start|><d>[English] You wake within me. Wake within me. You're in my heart forever. You wake within me. Wake within me.</d><|lyrics_end|>
Her mouth forms each word's vowel and consonant shapes in time with the copied track — "you" rounds the lips, "wake" opens wide on the long "ay" vowel, "within" runs through the "w-i-th-i-n" sequence, "me" closes softly, "heart" and "forever" stretch on their longer syllables — so the lip movements are a perfect visual match to <Audio 1>, line by line, with no invented, substituted or mumbled lyrics and no re-synthesized voice. Her jaw relaxes and lifts with each phrase and the pink satin ribbon bow and the pale-pink teddy-bear charm sway very slightly in a light breeze. The warm-gold sunrise enters from frame left and rims the outer edge of her right cheek, the loose strands of her high side ponytail, and the hem of her white pleated skirt with a bright golden edge, while the cool cyan counter-light from the upper right fills the shadow side of her cropped pink cardigan. Oblique godray shafts pass diagonally behind her through the mist. Behind her the background falls into a soft creamy bokeh of mist and grass with two small bloomed highlights; defocused teal-grey mountain silhouettes sit along the low horizon. The camera drifts almost imperceptibly, a slow lateral track of roughly zero point two meters per second combined with a micro push-in, never cutting away.

overall_soundscape:
The audio is fully copied from <Audio 1>; no added diegetic sound beyond the source vocal track.
